summary: Versioned host API and remote-operation messages multiplexed through authenticated WebSockets and the AxoHostRelay Durable Object.
transport: HTTPS WebSocket upgrade through Worker routes /v1/hosts/:host/:role and account-scoped relay routes; the Durable Object pairs daemon and client peers for a host.
framing: JSON-RPC 2.0 text frames, optionally batches of at most 8 calls. Frame maximum 65,536 bytes; strict calls/replies parsed with Zod. Per-peer 30 calls per rolling second; peer schema tracks negotiated state, bounded delivery window and host subscriptions. Pending operation and outbound delivery queues are bounded; oversized reply groups preserve each request ID and batch shape while converting outcomes to reconciliation-required errors.
version: Protocol version 1 negotiated before non-negotiate methods; daemon registration pins host generation and lease.

messages.name: axo.host.register
messages.summary: Daemon registers host ID, generation, label, kind, capabilities and initial session snapshot; returns host metadata.

messages.name: axo.host.heartbeat / axo.host.sessions.publish
messages.summary: Renews an admitted daemon lease and publishes current session snapshots.

messages.name: axo.host.subscribe / axo.host.unsubscribe
messages.summary: Client establishes or removes a host-generation-scoped event subscription.

messages.name: axo.host.event
messages.summary: Daemon-originated host.data wraps session snapshots/removals, shell activity, base64 terminal.output and Pi events with host ID and generation; the relay forwards to matching subscribed clients. Terminal bytes are ephemeral, while account Pi events are persisted in session history.

messages.name: axo.host.event notification
messages.summary: The relay sends subscription-scoped host notifications to subscribed clients; presence changes identify online/offline host generation.

messages.name: axo.remote.session.create / axo.remote.workspace.session.create / axo.remote.session.close
messages.summary: Client requests session lifecycle operations at the designated host generation.

messages.name: axo.remote.shell.create / axo.remote.shell.close / axo.remote.session.layout.set
messages.summary: Client changes remote shell catalog and layout.

parsing.summary: Worker authenticates the principal and validates route role, UUID host, origin, upgrade, lease, peer identity and method parameters; result schemas are checked before metadata replies are returned. Host-targeted requests must match the live route's generation.

compatibility: Host v1 is advertised; legacy machine register/heartbeat methods remain enabled for existing clients. Durable Object schema migration adapts older route/pending tables. A stale generation is fenced and clients must reconcile unknown outcomes.
